title: Study Scholarship for Domestic Students
summary: Scholarship for domestic students enrolled at a university in Germany, an EU country, or Switzerland who are eligible for BAföG Section 8.

degree_levels.notes: Covers Bachelor's, Diplom, Magister, State Examination, and Master's programs.

subject_areas.notes: Domestic and international students of all disciplines are welcome to apply.

values: university in Germany, an EU country, or Switzerland (state-run or state-recognized)
institutions.notes: University must be state-run or state-recognized.

nationality.notes: Domestic students and those belonging to the group of people eligible for BAföG Section 8.

residence.notes: Enrolled at a university in Germany, an EU country, or Switzerland.

mandatory.text: Belong to the group of people eligible for BAföG Section 8
Strong commitment to the Rosa Luxemburg Foundation
Enrolled at a state-run or state-recognized university in Germany, an EU country, or Switzerland

exceptions.text: A second full-time degree program is not eligible
Part-time (work-based) study program is not eligible
Students with a part-time job of more than 20 hours per week are not eligible
Study in Great Britain is not eligible

funding.description: No specific cash stipend amount stated on the page.

application_rounds.notes: Application deadline mentioned for second-semester Master's is October 1st, but no specific round dates provided for general applications.

recurring_deadline_notes: Master's program application deadline of October 1st is mentioned.

sources.title: Study scholarship - Rosa-Luxemburg-Stiftung
sources.notes: In scope because international students/EU nationals or those studying in Germany can receive funding for physical study in Germany.
